story.title: Ava's Habitat Helpers
story.introLine: Welcome, Ava! Today we are exploring where animals live and how they stay safe and happy.
story.closingLine: Great job, Ava! Now, can you help these animals find their perfect homes?

scenes.title: The Sunny Savanna
scenes.narration: Look at this golden grassland! A tall giraffe reaches for green leaves with its long neck, while a lion rests in the shade. Animals here need fur that blends with the dry grass to stay hidden and safe.
scenes.imagePrompt: Polished 2d children educational game art of a sunny African savanna with a giraffe eating from an acacia tree and a lion resting in tall golden grass, bright blue sky, no text.

scenes.title: The Icy Arctic
scenes.narration: Brrr! In the snowy Arctic, everything is white and chilly. Polar bears have thick, warm fur to protect them from the freezing wind. They use their strong paws to walk across the slippery ice to find their dinner.
scenes.imagePrompt: Polished 2d children educational game art of a snowy Arctic landscape with a fluffy white polar bear standing on a blue ice floe under a soft winter sun, no text.

narration.transcript: Welcome, Ava! Today we are exploring where animals live and how they stay safe and happy. Look at this golden grassland! A tall giraffe reaches for green leaves with its long neck, while a lion rests in the shade. Animals here need fur that blends with the dry grass to stay hidden and safe. Brrr! In the snowy Arctic, everything is white and chilly. Polar bears have thick, warm fur to protect them from the freezing wind. They use their strong paws to walk across the slippery ice to find their dinner. Great job, Ava! Now, can you help these animals find their perfect homes?
